final_architecture.name: Serverless
final_architecture.design_rationale: Serverless functions around Product, Order, Cart workflows with managed data and cache layers. Auto-scales to zero during idle periods and pay-per-use pricing; cold starts and vendor lock-in are trade-offs. Selected through 3 multi-agent evolutionary cycles, achieving a final multi-objective fitness of 86.2/100. Incorporates 5 components tailored for E-commerce platform with sync messaging.
